method: Stratified sample (100) across trade x status; each sampled license compared field-by-field (license number/type/subtype, dates, status, verification, status source, holder, business name/phone/address/county, endorsements, insurance) against its re-parsed source CSV row. Business contact fields compared only for single-license businesses (merged businesses may legitimately carry a sibling's contact). No PII values in this file — pass/fail booleans only.
source: PostgreSQL housecraftpros vs fresh CSVs downloaded 25/11/2026
